dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: 王明，你们班有多少同学？
dialogue.reading: Wáng Míng, nǐmen bān yǒu duōshao tóngxué?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Wǒmen bān yǒu sānshí ge tóngxué.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Nǐmen měitiān dōu yǒu kè ma?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 对，星期一到星期五都有课。
dialogue.reading: Duì, xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ dōu yǒu kè.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 六月考试。考试以前，我们都很忙！
dialogue.reading: Liù yuè kǎoshì. Kǎoshì yǐqián, wǒmen dōu hěn máng!
